设 $u=\ln\sqrt{x^2+y^2+z^2}$，则 $\operatorname{div}(\operatorname{grad}u)_{(1,1,1)}$ 为（ ） $0$ $\frac13$ $2$ $1$ 参考答案：

$$grad\,u=(u_x,u_y,u_z)=\left(\frac{x}{x^2+y^2+z^2},\frac{y}{x^2+y^2+z^2},\frac{z}{x^2+y^2+z^2}\right)$$

$$div(grad\,u)=\frac{\partial\left(\frac{x}{x^2+y^2+z^2}\right)}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial\left(\frac{y}{x^2+y^2+z^2}\right)}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial\left(\frac{z}{x^2+y^2+z^2}\right)}{\partial z}=\frac{1}{3}$$
